story.body: You stopped at the post and read both bills, the Rose's before your own.
You put a hand on the doorpost and looked at the heavens.

participation.context: Named the gear, the count and the letter, and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You counted fifty-two shillings, fourteen lines, five men back on ten shillings, and an oath that sounded long. You did not begin the letter.

title: Felt the company drop back into its six-day gear
